P20-03.name: Perfect Strike Gundam
P20-03.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Return an opposing Nexus to the deckbottom.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Return two opposing 10000 BP or less Spirits to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] Cost 4 or less
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Cost 4 or less effects.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can't be blocked.
